text:
jordan: Morning folks, first-day snag. Okta accepted my password but then the flow says 'No factors available' and won't let me enroll MFA. Also I never got a 1Password invite and drive.redwood.ai shows 'request access' for the onboarding folder. Who should I ping?

priya-it: Welcome @jordan! Sorry about that. Two quick things to check: 1) confirm the email you used to accept the invite (work vs personal), 2) do you see any pending invites in spam? Which OS/browser are you on?

jordan: I'm on macOS Monterey, Chrome. I accepted the invite at jordan@redwood.ai. No invite in spam. Okta profile shows account as "Staged" though, and under factors it lists nothing.

security-bot: Ticket created: ONB-6120 — "Jordan: staged Okta user, missing factors, 1P + Drive access". Assigned to priya-it. ETA 90 minutes.

priya-it: Aha staged status explains it. Our provisioning pipeline sometimes leaves contractor/early-invite accounts in Staged if HR flags aren't finished. I'll promote you to Active, resend 1Password, and give temporary Drive access. Hold on.

omar: FYI @priya-it you might also need to add jordan to the device-enroll app mapping; we've seen cases where Active + no app mapping => no factor options.

priya-it: Good call. I promoted the account to Active, added the Okta apps mapping, and resent the 1Password invite. Also enabled a 2-hour allowlist for the onboarding Drive folder so you can get docs.

jordan: Got the 1Password invite now. Installed and added an Authenticator TOTP entry, but Okta still shows no factors until I re-open the SSO flow.

priya-it: Try clearing cookies for okta.redwood.ai and then open the SSO link: https://okta.redwood.ai/signin. Also you can try enrolling a passkey in Safari (if you prefer) after device trust completes.

jordan: Cleared cookies, re-signed in and now Okta prompts to register a factor. TOTP worked. Drive access also opened and I can see the onboarding folder. 1Password vaults synced.

jordan: Quick follow-up: when I try to create a passkey in Chrome it doesn't show in Okta as an option. Is that expected?

omar: Passkeys sometimes surface only after Device Trust shows 'Enrolled' and the browser supports WebAuthn for the origin. If you want passkey ASAP: create it in Safari (native WebAuthn) or enroll device trust first (Settings -> Profiles -> allow Jamf).

priya-it: I've flagged the account for passkey eligibility. Once you enroll device trust the passkey option should appear. We'll migrate you to passkey-only later this week.

jordan: Cool — I enrolled the device trust profile, passkey option appeared, I created a passkey in Safari and Okta shows it as registered. All onboarding access looks good now, thanks y'all!

priya-it: Great — closing ONB-6120 after a quick audit. Welcome to Redwood! Ping #new-hires or DM me if anything else pops up.

jordan: Thanks! I'll confirm access to a couple team folders and then close the allowlist.
